title: UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Answer Key 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
postName: Teacher Cadre JTC / HTC Grade Assistant Teacher – Advt. 03-Exam/2026
vacancyDetails: 58 posts of Assistant Teacher (JTC/HTC Grade including Music and special education related posts)
qualification: 10+2 with Diploma in Special Education / RCI registration and PET score as per advt
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on 01 July 2026 (relaxations apply)
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open Answer Key for Teacher Cadre JTC Advt 03-Exam/2026
3. Download notice and question paper with answer key PDF
4. Match your responses
5. Follow objection process if notified
shortDescription: UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Answer Key 2026 out on 13 July for mains on 12 July 2026 (58 posts, Advt 03-Exam/2026).
content:
UPSSSC has released the Teacher Cadre JTC Answer Key 2026 on 13 July 2026 for the mains exam held on 12 July 2026.

Advt. No. 03-Exam/2026 covers 58 Assistant Teacher (JTC/HTC Grade) posts. Download key and notice from upsssc.gov.in.
